-- Harkinan Hub V2

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "HarkinanHub"
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Parent = gui
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,320,0,280)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-160,0.5,-140)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120,0,0)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner",frame)
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke",frame)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
stroke.Thickness = 2

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Parent = frame
title.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,45)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160,0,0)
title.Text = "Harkinan Hub"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.TextScaled = true

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner",title)
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)

local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Parent = frame
container.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-45)
container.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,45)
container.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local function createButton(name,pos,script)

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Parent = container
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,34)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05,0,0,pos)
	btn.Text = name
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,0,0)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	btn.TextScaled = true

	local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner",btn)
	btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,10)

	local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke",btn)
	btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet(script))()
	end)

end

createButton("Achromatic - Noober",10,"https://rawscripts.net/raw/UP-Just-a-baseplate.-Fe-achromatic-by-noober-123067")

-- Toggle with RightShift
local open = true

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,gp)
	if gp then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then

		open = not open

		if open then
			frame.Visible = true
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)

			TweenService:Create(
				frame,
				TweenInfo.new(0.25,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),
				{Size = UDim2.new(0,320,0,280)}
			):Play()
		else
			frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end)
